page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv6 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor running at 4.2 GHz, configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB per core ratio. It features 118 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks reveal a notable contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The server demonstrates strong single-core performance, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2105.0 and average single-threaded compression and decompression rates. However, multi-core and memory-intensive operations are limited. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and large-block memory bandwidth read/write speeds are categorized as poor, reflecting the constraints of the single physical core architecture.

Given its hardware profile, the D2ds_v6 offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation but do not demand high parallel processing power. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic text processing, and small-scale application hosting. However, it is poorly suited for software compilation, heavy database operations, or multi-threaded workloads due to its low multi-core benchmark results and weak memory bandwidth.
